answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks when every identity must climb a reputation ridge one verified job at a time: each completed task earns a signed receipt chained to the last, and a newcomer starts with no credit, like an island cut off from trusted trade until it proves itself. Peers re-check identities with a regular pulse of random audits — any account that fails an audit or forges a receipt loses its locked stake and its chain. A thousand fake identities need a thousand deposits and a thousand verified jobs, so forgery costs far more than honest work.
